      *-----------------------
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
      *-----------------------
       PROGRAM-ID.    FXSORT
       AUTHOR.        Jeff Bisti
      *--------------------
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
      *--------------------
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT FXLIST-B ASSIGN TO FXBOSS.
           SELECT FXLIST-M ASSIGN TO FXMXR.
           SELECT FXLIST-J ASSIGN TO FXJHS.
           SELECT FXLIST-WORK ASSIGN TO WRK.
           SELECT FXLIST-MERGE ASSIGN TO FXLSTMRG.
           SELECT FXLIST-SORTED ASSIGN TO FXSORTED.
      *-------------
       DATA DIVISION.
      *-------------
       FILE SECTION.
       SD  FXLIST-WORK.
       01  FX-REC.
           05 FX-NAME-W      PIC X(50).
           05 FX-PRICE-W     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05 FILLER PIC X(17).
      *
       FD  FXLIST-MERGE RECORDING MODE F.
       01 FX-MERG.
           05 FX-NAME-M      PIC X(50).
           05 FX-PRICE-M     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05 FILLER PIC X(17).

       FD  FXLIST-SORTED RECORDING MODE F.
       01  PRINT-REC.
           05  FX-NAME-S      PIC X(50).
           05  FX-PRICE-S     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05  FILLER PIC X(17).
      *
       FD  FXLIST-B RECORDING MODE F.
       01  BOSS-FIELDS.
           05  FX-NAME-B      PIC X(50).
           05  FX-PRICE-B     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05  FILLER PIC X(17).
      *
       FD  FXLIST-M RECORDING MODE F.
       01  MXR-FIELDS.
           05  FX-NAME-M       PIC X(50).
           05  FX-PRICE-M     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05  FILLER PIC X(17).
      *
       FD  FXLIST-J RECORDING MODE F.
       01  JHS-FIELDS.
           05  FX-NAME-I       PIC X(50).
           05  FX-PRICE-I     PIC $$,$$$,$$9.99.
           05  FILLER PIC X(17).
      *

      *------------------
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
      *------------------


       PROCESS-RECORDS.
           DISPLAY "MERGING FILES"
           MERGE FXLIST-WORK ON ASCENDING KEY FX-NAME-W IN FX-REC
           USING FXLIST-B, FXLIST-M, FXLIST-J GIVING FXLIST-MERGE

           DISPLAY "SORTING RECORDS".
           SORT FXLIST-WORK ON ASCENDING KEY FX-PRICE-W IN FX-REC
           USING FXLIST-MERGE GIVING FXLIST-SORTED
           .

       CLOSE-STOP.
           DISPLAY "NOW I'M STOPPING".
           STOP RUN.

plan.approach: The COBOL program performs two classic mainframe file operations: (1) MERGE — combine three flat files ordered by FX-NAME ascending into one intermediate file, and (2) SORT — re-order the merged intermediate file by FX-PRICE ascending into the final output file. The modernization maps each flat file to a dedicated PostgreSQL table (fx_boss, fx_mxr, fx_jhs, fx_merged, fx_sorted), preserves the two-stage pipeline as explicit transactional service methods, and boots as a Spring Boot CommandRunner application that seeds data from CSV files (replacing the physical flat files) then executes and exits — exactly mirroring the COBOL STOP RUN semantics.
patterns_used: Repository Pattern (Spring Data JPA) — one repository per table replacing each FD/SD file descriptor
MappedSuperclass inheritance — FxRecord base captures the common PIC X(50) + PIC 9 field layout shared by all COBOL 01-level records
Service Layer — FxSortService encapsulates the PROCEDURE DIVISION paragraphs (PROCESS-RECORDS, CLOSE-STOP) as discrete methods
ApplicationRunner with ordered execution — AppConfig (order 1) seeds CSV data; FxSortRunner (order 2) triggers business logic, mirroring the sequential COBOL program flow
Transactional boundary — the entire MERGE + SORT pipeline is wrapped in a single @Transactional method ensuring atomicity
Stream API with Comparator — Java Streams replace the COBOL MERGE/SORT verbs with in-memory ordered-merge and stable sort operations before bulk persistence
TRUNCATE + saveAll pattern — output tables (fx_merged, fx_sorted) are truncated before each run to ensure idempotency, matching the overwrite semantics of the COBOL GIVING clause
plan.sql_strategy: No EXEC SQL blocks existed in the original COBOL; all I/O was flat-file based. The flat files are mapped to PostgreSQL tables. Spring Data JPA derived-query methods (findAllByOrderByFxNameAsc, findAllByOrderByFxPriceAsc) replace sequential file reads. Native @Query TRUNCATE statements handle output-table reset. The MERGE and SORT ordering logic is performed in Java via Stream.sorted() with the appropriate Comparator before bulk-inserting results via saveAll(), keeping the SQL layer as simple CRUD and avoiding complex SQL that would obscure the business logic.
plan.call_strategy: The original COBOL program contains no CALL statements. The two COBOL verbs (MERGE and SORT) are not inter-program calls but language built-ins; they are implemented as private methods (mergeFiles() and sortRecords()) within FxSortService, called sequentially from the processRecords() entry point — preserving the paragraph-level structure of the PROCEDURE DIVISION.
